title: Deactivation Causes and Their Priority for Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** A Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account is deactivated for exactly one controlled cause, checked in this order of priority:

1. **Zero-tolerance violation** — when the investigation substantiates a recorded violation on the level's zero-tolerance list.
2. **Violation points** — when the account's active violation points reach the level's deactivation threshold.
3. **Documents expired** — when a licence or insurance expiry date has passed by more than the level's document grace days on an account at a level that requires a vehicle.
4. **Rating below floor** — which applies only after a rating warning has stood for the full cure period. The cure period is counted in calendar days with the rating warning date as day 0, and deactivation for rating is allowed only from the day after the rating warning date plus the level's cure days, and only if the rating average is then below the level's rating floor.

Acceptance rate is never a cause. Batches already accepted are paid under the pay rules of Cartwise Shopper Batches.

## Figures by level

| Level | Deactivation threshold (active points at or above) | Document grace days | Warning cure days | Rating floor (average below) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 10 | 0 (no vehicle required) | 14 | 4.5 |
| Full-Service Shopper | 10 | 7 | 14 | 4.6 |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 12 | 7 | 14 | 4.6 |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 12 | 7 | 21 | 4.6 |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 14 | 14 | 21 | 4.6 |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 16 | 14 | 30 | 4.6 |

## The cure period at its edges (hypothetical dates)

A Full-Service Shopper Gold receives a rating warning dated 3 June, day 0. 3 June plus 21 days is 24 June.

| Date | Deactivation for rating allowed |
|---|---|
| 24 June, average 4.52 | No — the cure period has not yet fully run |
| 25 June, average 4.52 | Yes — from the day after 24 June, and 4.52 is below 4.6 |
| 25 June, average 4.63 | No — the average is not below the floor |

## One cause only

Where two causes are met together, the higher one in the list is the cause recorded. A hypothetical Full-Service Shopper with 11 active points whose licence expired more than 7 days ago is deactivated for violation points, the second cause, not for documents expired.
